result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but the favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card is styled with a dark fill so the heart is nearly invisible, and the first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail has a washed-out background inconsistent with its siblings.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' uses a dark (near-black) circular background with a dark outlined heart, making it almost invisible against the dark image. The equivalent button on the ramen card above is white with a dark heart, so the styling is inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use the same white/translucent circle with a dark heart outline for all favorite buttons, ensuring at least 3:1 contrast between the icon and its background.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a very light, near-white background while the neighboring cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually inconsistent and the white '15–25 min' badge sits on a pale background with weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (e.g., consistent image background or a subtle gradient overlay) and ensure the duration badge keeps sufficient contrast on light images.
